chunks.text:
[Intro]
{stepping out under the whole sky: a soft clockwork tick begins, a slow glassy arpeggio unfolds upward like the dome opening, one high bell, then the lead enters}
positive_styles: A minor resolving to C major
lonely spacious pulse-wave lead with long notes and wide intervals
slow glassy arpeggiated pad of broken chords like turning starlight
faint dry clockwork tick on a steady subdivision instead of a drum kit
vast, lonely, reverent, wondrous star-observatory town theme

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{the lonely star melody in A minor: a slow wide rising leap that hangs in the air, unfolding over the slow arpeggio, clockwork ticking beneath}
positive_styles: A minor resolving to C major
lonely spacious pulse-wave lead with long notes and wide intervals
slow glassy arpeggiated pad of broken chords like turning starlight
faint dry clockwork tick on a steady subdivision instead of a drum kit
vast, lonely, reverent, wondrous star-observatory town theme

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Reprise]
{the melody again, now answered by a soft second voice a phrase later across the dome, strings warming underneath}
positive_styles: A minor resolving to C major
lonely spacious pulse-wave lead with long notes and wide intervals
slow glassy arpeggiated pad of broken chords like turning starlight
faint dry clockwork tick on a steady subdivision instead of a drum kit

chunks.text:
[Bridge]
{contrast: the lift to C major and F major - the melody opens into hope, bells brightening like constellations relighting one by one, a near-dawn glow, then easing back to A minor}
positive_styles: A minor resolving to C major

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Return]
{the lonely melody returns under the stars; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme, no ending}
